featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely terrible drive-through experience. We waited at the drive-through ordering point for a long time and even honked multiple times, but nobody came to take our order. After a lengthy wait, a staff member finally approached us only to tell us to come inside the restaurant to place the order and make the payment.

This completely defeats the purpose of having a drive-through. If customers are expected to park, walk inside, place the order, and pay at the counter, then why advertise a drive-through service at all?

The entire experience was frustrating, unprofessional, and a complete waste of time. A drive-through is meant to provide convenience and speed, but this outlet failed to deliver even the most basic level of service. Management seriously needs to improve staff responsiveness and ensure the drive-through operates as intended.
